BiblicalUsage: In the Bible, thnētós means mortal, liable to die. In Romans 6:12, Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body. The word turns up 6 times, and each time it points to the same reality.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe my mortality is not a hopeless fact but the reason the resurrection matters so much. That is why I come back to thnētós whenever I need to remember what is true.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
